scope: evaluation only; F1 checkpoints; no r32 or confirmation episodes
threshold_scope: one per writer/rank/variant family and criterion, shared across all three training seeds
selection: maximum validation mean accuracy, equally weighting eight hops and three seeds; ties: fewer mean steps, then smaller threshold
selection_barrier: thresholds saved after every validation trace and before any screening test evaluation
halting_convention: after update L>=1, predict from z^L; read norm uses UMQz^L relative to UMQz^0; change uses norm(z^L-z^(L-1))/norm(z^(L-1)); stability threshold is consecutive unchanged argmax pairs ending at L; first hit or cap 16
read_norm_cost: cached next-step read; L+1 Mq operations for a query halting at update L, including the terminal diagnostic read
oracle_reference: stop at true hop; label-informed reference, not a guarantee of maximal accuracy for a learned reader
certificate: FP64 exact spectral norms in abs(rho)*(norm(R)+norm(U)*norm(M)*norm(Q)); one c per episode; c>=1 is inconclusive, not proof of divergence

latency.scope: prepared-memory reader plus candidate-restricted prediction and required stopping bookkeeping; no writer/backbone preparation
latency.clock: CUDA events plus synchronized wall time
latency.input_selection: batch64: one query per episode cycling hops 1..8; batch1: eight separate queries, one per hop; same inputs for all methods
